summary.text: Angélica María Dueñas is a Democratic candidate challenging incumbent Luz Maria Rivas for California's 29th Congressional District. A human resources professional and former neighborhood council officer, she was a Southern California campaign coordinator for Jill Stein's 2016 presidential campaign and a Bernie Sanders delegate. She has run for this seat before and describes herself as a progressive whose platform includes Medicare for All and a Green New Deal.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in political science and public administration from California State University, Los Angeles, in 2007 and a master's degree in organizational leadership from Woodbury University in 2013.
Worked as a human resources manager at Gravity Defyer and as a human resources specialist.
Worked as the Southern California campaign coordinator for Jill Stein's 2016 presidential campaign.
Served as president and vice president of the Sun Valley Area Neighborhood Council.
Served as a member of the Bernie Sanders delegation to the 2016 and 2020 Democratic National Conventions.
Ran for this seat in 2020 and 2022, advancing to the general election both times and losing to incumbent Tony Cárdenas.
